strings.name: Luka Modrić
strings.summary: Modrić grew up displaced by war and progressed through Croatian youth football and loans to England and Real Madrid. His control, distribution and judgment made him a world-class midfielder. He helped Madrid win six Champions Leagues, led Croatia to World Cup silver in 2018 and bronze in 2022, and won the 2018 Ballon d'Or. He joined AC Milan in 2025 and renewed in 2026.
